# smalldi

> Annotation-driven dependency injection for Python: classes are registered as singletons or interfaces with `Injector` decorators, functions decorated with `@Injector.inject` receive instances for parameters annotated `Provide[T]`, and `with Injector.context(kind):` scopes registrations, overrides and instances to a block. Requires Python >=3.11, has zero runtime dependencies, MIT license.

smalldi is a small library with a single static registry, `Injector`. `@Injector.singleton` registers a class, `@Injector.interface` registers an abstract class, `@Injector.implements(Interface)` and `@Injector.override(Target)` bind singletons to interfaces or to other singletons, and `@Injector.inject` fills `Provide[T]` parameters. `Injector.get_instance(T)` returns the instance for a registered singleton or interface. The package ships type information (`py.typed`).

Singletons are lazy: `@Injector.singleton` does not instantiate the class. The instance is created the first time it is requested, at most once per class, and the constructor must take no arguments or be decorated with `@Injector.inject`. Registering the same class twice raises `TypeError`; a reloaded module defines new class objects that are registered as additional singletons, so module reloading is not supported.

Interfaces: an interface is an `abc.ABC` subclass with at least one abstract method, registered with `@Injector.interface`. Exactly one singleton may be declared as its implementation with `@Injector.implements(Interface)`, applied above `@Injector.singleton`; the class must be a subclass of the interface. `Provide[Interface]` injects the implementation's instance, the same object `Provide[Implementation]` receives. A second implementation raises `RuntimeError`; calling an injected function while the interface has neither an implementation nor an override raises `RuntimeError`.

Overrides: `@Injector.override(Target, when=lambda: ...)`, applied above `@Injector.singleton`, makes the decorated singleton the instance injected for `Target` only when `when()` returns `True`; `when` is called once, when the decorator is applied (at import time), and when it returns `False`, the decorator is a no-op and leaves bindings unchanged. `Target` is a registered singleton or interface. The target's class, or the interface's implementation, is never instantiated through the injector, and an interface override wins whatever the order of declaration. When enabled, the override must be a registered singleton and a subclass of the target, and a class cannot override itself. Overrides are a single delegation hop and are not transitive: an override cannot be overridden, an overridden singleton cannot become an override, and both raise `TypeError`. Each target has at most one override; a second one raises `RuntimeError` for a singleton target and `TypeError` for an interface target. An interface whose implementation is overridden resolves to the implementation's override. Validation happens before anything is bound.

Freezing: a singleton or interface is frozen the first time an instance is requested through it, even if the constructor raised or the interface had no binding. Overriding a frozen target raises `SingletonFrozenError`, importable from `smalldi`. A frozen interface still accepts a first implementation if it already has an override. A singleton target may be overridden by a class that was already injected, and then shares its instance; if that class was requested but has no instance (its constructor is running or raised), the override raises `SingletonFrozenError`. Reading the deprecated `Injector.singletons_available` instantiates and freezes every registered singleton.

`@Injector.inject` checks at decoration time that every `Provide[T]` names a registered singleton or interface (`TypeError` otherwise) and resolves the instances at every call, in the context current at that call, so overrides declared after decoration but before the first call are respected, and an interface needs a binding only by the time the function is called. A keyword argument passed by the caller replaces the injected value. On an `async def` function, `@Injector.inject` returns a coroutine function that resolves `Provide[T]` when the coroutine starts running, not when the function is called.

Contexts: an `InjectionContext` is one registry of singletons and one of interfaces. `with Injector.context(kind):` makes a child context current for the block; `kind` is a member of `smalldi.context.InjectionSubcontextType` and defaults to `RESET`. `PRESERVE` pushes the same `InjectionContext` object as the current one. `RESET` keeps the same registrations, implementations and overrides but gives every singleton a fresh, unfrozen `LazySingleton` without an instance; classes sharing one singleton through an override keep sharing one, and interfaces are rebound to the new singletons. `EMPTY` has nothing registered. `SHALLOW` is a new registry dict holding the same `LazySingleton` objects, so instances and frozen state are shared with the parent; singletons registered inside are invisible to the parent, but overriding an inherited singleton inside mutates the shared object and is visible in the parent. `STACK` makes each singleton's effective class (its override if any, else its own class) the base of a fresh singleton with no override, keeps classes that shared one singleton sharing one, and turns an interface's override into its implementation so it can be overridden again. `Injector.context(kind)` and `Injector.foreign_context(ctx)` return a single-use context manager: nothing is pushed until `__enter__`, the child is built from the context current at `__enter__` time, `__enter__` returns the `InjectionContext`, `__exit__` pops exactly the context the manager pushed, exiting out of order raises `RuntimeError` and leaves the stack unchanged, and entering the same manager twice raises `RuntimeError`. `Injector.get_context()` returns the current context. A registration goes into the context current when the decorator runs; Python caches modules, so a module first imported inside `with Injector.context(...)` keeps its registrations in that context only: import modules at the root. A request for an instance freezes what it looks up in the current context; a `RESET` or `STACK` child starts unfrozen.

Execution slices: contexts are tracked per execution slice, the running `asyncio.Task` if code runs inside a Task, otherwise the current `threading.Thread` object. A slice with nothing pushed sees the root context. A native `threading.Thread` starts in the root context regardless of the context of the thread that created it; `smalldi.thread.ContextAwareThread` captures the creator's current `InjectionContext` in `__init__` (by reference, not a copy) and enters it for the duration of `run()`. An `asyncio.Task` starts in the root context; opening injection contexts inside coroutines is not supported. If a slice ends with contexts still open, they are removed and a `ResourceWarning` is emitted.

Threads: the injector may be used from several threads. Each singleton is constructed at most once per context; other threads requesting the same instance wait for the constructor. No lock guarding the registry or a binding is held while a constructor runs. One `InjectionContext` may be current for several threads (`PRESERVE`, `SHALLOW`, `ContextAwareThread`), which is safe because every access goes through `Injector` under its class mutex. A binding racing the first injection of its target either wins or is refused with `SingletonFrozenError`. Circular dependencies within one thread raise `RuntimeError`. Known limitation: a dependency cycle spanning several threads, or a constructor waiting for another thread that needs the singleton being constructed, is not detected and may deadlock.

Also included: `Container`, a singleton base class that collects classes and functions registered with `@MyContainer.component`; `Collector.collect_from_package`, which imports every module of a package so decorators run; and `smalldi.concurrency` with the `@synchronized` and `@threadsafe` lock decorators.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/0xf104a/smalldi/blob/master/README.md): singletons, containers, interfaces and contexts, each with an example followed by its rules
- [Singletons](https://github.com/0xf104a/smalldi/blob/master/README.md#singletons): lazy instantiation, exactly once, and the module reload warning
- [Injector.singletons_available (deprecated)](https://github.com/0xf104a/smalldi/blob/master/README.md#injectorsingletons_available-deprecated): the deprecated snapshot and what reading it does
- [Interfaces](https://github.com/0xf104a/smalldi/blob/master/README.md#interfaces): `@Injector.interface`, `@Injector.implements` and `Provide[Interface]`
- [Overrides](https://github.com/0xf104a/smalldi/blob/master/README.md#overrides): `@Injector.override` for singletons and interfaces, the non-transitivity rules
- [Overrides: freezing](https://github.com/0xf104a/smalldi/blob/master/README.md#overrides): what freezes a target and `SingletonFrozenError`, in the Overrides rules
- [How singletons work](https://github.com/0xf104a/smalldi/blob/master/README.md#how-singletons-work): exactly-once construction across threads, circular dependencies and the undetected deadlock cases
- [Contexts](https://github.com/0xf104a/smalldi/blob/master/README.md#contexts): `Injector.context(kind)`, the five context kinds, per-slice tracking, `ContextAwareThread` and the import caveat
- [docs/index.md](https://github.com/0xf104a/smalldi/blob/master/docs/index.md): index of the documentation pages
- [docs/architecture.md](https://github.com/0xf104a/smalldi/blob/master/docs/architecture.md): entity diagram of the injector's objects, what `Injector.get_instance` and `@Injector.override` do step by step
- [docs/contexts.md](https://github.com/0xf104a/smalldi/blob/master/docs/contexts.md): each context kind with a before/after diagram, context trees per thread and task, stack unwinding, the import caveat and the coroutine limitation
- [docs/concurrency.md](https://github.com/0xf104a/smalldi/blob/master/docs/concurrency.md): the locks, freeze-on-lookup, override refusals, detected and undetected cycles
- [Containers](https://github.com/0xf104a/smalldi/blob/master/README.md#containers): collecting components in a singleton container
- [Concurrency](https://github.com/0xf104a/smalldi/blob/master/README.md#concurrency): the `@synchronized` and `@threadsafe` decorators and their limitations
- [Collector](https://github.com/0xf104a/smalldi/blob/master/README.md#collector): importing a package's modules to run their decorators
- [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/0xf104a/smalldi/blob/master/CHANGELOG.md): changes per release, including what 0.3.0 changes for 0.2.0 users
- [smalldi/__init__.py](https://github.com/0xf104a/smalldi/blob/master/src/smalldi/__init__.py): `Injector`, its decorators, `get_instance`, and the deprecated `singletons_available`
- [smalldi/_singleton.py](https://github.com/0xf104a/smalldi/blob/master/src/smalldi/_singleton.py): `LazySingleton`, delegation to an override, freezing, `SingletonFrozenError`
- [smalldi/_interfaces.py](https://github.com/0xf104a/smalldi/blob/master/src/smalldi/_interfaces.py): interface bindings to implementations and overrides
- [smalldi/context.py](https://github.com/0xf104a/smalldi/blob/master/src/smalldi/context.py): `InjectionContext`, `InjectionSubcontextType` and `InjectionContextManager`
- [smalldi/_context/__init__.py](https://github.com/0xf104a/smalldi/blob/master/src/smalldi/_context/__init__.py): `InjectionContextRegistry`, the per-slice current context and the `ResourceWarning` for contexts left open
- [smalldi/_context/tree.py](https://github.com/0xf104a/smalldi/blob/master/src/smalldi/_context/tree.py): `ContextTree`, the per-slice context stacks
- [smalldi/thread.py](https://github.com/0xf104a/smalldi/blob/master/src/smalldi/thread.py): `ContextAwareThread`
- [smalldi/annotation.py](https://github.com/0xf104a/smalldi/blob/master/src/smalldi/annotation.py): the `Provide[T]` annotation
- [smalldi/container.py](https://github.com/0xf104a/smalldi/blob/master/src/smalldi/container.py): `Container` and `ComponentRegistration`
- [smalldi/collector.py](https://github.com/0xf104a/smalldi/blob/master/src/smalldi/collector.py): `Collector.collect_from_package`
- [smalldi/concurrency.py](https://github.com/0xf104a/smalldi/blob/master/src/smalldi/concurrency.py): `@synchronized`, `@threadsafe` and the `mutex` helper
- [smalldi/decorator.py](https://github.com/0xf104a/smalldi/blob/master/src/smalldi/decorator.py): `staticclass`
- [smalldi/atomic.py](https://github.com/0xf104a/smalldi/blob/master/src/smalldi/atomic.py): `AtomicSet`
- [smalldi/wrappers.py](https://github.com/0xf104a/smalldi/blob/master/src/smalldi/wrappers.py): compatibility alias of `smalldi.decorator`
- [pyproject.toml](https://github.com/0xf104a/smalldi/blob/master/pyproject.toml): package metadata, `requires-python` and the empty dependency list

## Optional

- [test_override_rules.py](https://github.com/0xf104a/smalldi/blob/master/src/tests/test_override_rules.py): specification of singleton overrides, non-transitivity, freezing and circular dependencies
- [test_interface_bindings.py](https://github.com/0xf104a/smalldi/blob/master/src/tests/test_interface_bindings.py): specification of interface implementations, overrides and freezing

- [test_context.py](https://github.com/0xf104a/smalldi/blob/master/src/tests/test_context.py): specification of the `RESET` and `STACK` context kinds and of the context manager lifecycle
